title: EFN - Poin Hangus (tidak aktif 12 bulan)
description: G22 (docs/04 §14.D.9, W-17): job BFF LoyaltyInactivityJob. Metrik Prometheus efn_loyalty_expiry_total{phase,outcome} (asumsi: satu inkremen per member per fase) dan efn_loyalty_expired_points_total{issuer}; heartbeat log EFN_LOYALTY_EXPIRY_RUN (Loki stream efn_loyalty, loyalty_event=expiry_run; hanya hitungan, tanpa member). Alert (milik devsecops): loki-rules/efn-loyalty.yml grup efn-loyalty-expiry (aborted = critical, error = warning, dead-man 26 jam); kegagalan notifikasi WA: alert-rules.yml grup efn-loyalty-expiry. Production: job OFF sampai Legal/Meta menyetujui (L-73) -> panel kosong itu wajar.

panels.title: Run dibatalkan (kandidat > batas, 26 jam)
panels.description: Jumlah baris EFN_LOYALTY_EXPIRY_RUN status aborted (LOYALTY_EXPIRY_MAX_PER_RUN terlampaui; tidak ada poin dihanguskan). > 0 = alert critical EfnLoyaltyExpiryAborted.

panels.title: Run gagal (26 jam)
panels.description: Baris status error per fase (alert warning EfnLoyaltyExpiryFailed).

panels.title: Kandidat expire run terakhir
panels.description: Nilai "candidates" baris EFN_LOYALTY_EXPIRY_RUN fase expire terakhir (26 jam), termasuk dry run. Bandingkan dengan LOYALTY_EXPIRY_MAX_PER_RUN (default 20 000).

targets.expr: max(last_over_time({stream="efn_loyalty", loyalty_event="expiry_run", expiry_phase="expire"} | regexp `"candidates":(?P<candidates>\d+)` | unwrap candidates | __error__="" [26h]))

panels.title: Notifikasi WA T-30 gagal (24 jam)
panels.description: increase(efn_loyalty_expiry_notice_failed_total) 24 jam. Hangus tetap berjalan walau notifikasi gagal (§14.D.4) -> tindak lanjut CRM/Legal.

panels.title: Poin hangus per hari per PT penerbit
panels.description: increase(efn_loyalty_expired_points_total{issuer}) per 1 hari. Dasar jurnal breakage di PT penerbit (L-67) tetap ledger BFF / akrual Odoo, bukan panel ini.

panels.title: Member per hari per fase (notice / expire / anonymize)
panels.description: increase(efn_loyalty_expiry_total{outcome="ok"}) per fase per 1 hari (asumsi: satu inkremen per member). Anonymize hanya bila LOYALTY_INACTIVE_ANONYMIZE aktif (OFF di production, L-73).

panels.title: Hasil run per fase & outcome (per hari)
panels.description: Semua outcome efn_loyalty_expiry_total (ok, dry_run, aborted, error, ...) per fase.

panels.title: Heartbeat EFN_LOYALTY_EXPIRY_RUN
panels.description: Satu baris per fase per run (hitungan per fase/penerbit; tanpa member, nomor, atau hash - dibatasi regex promtail).
